device_entry.name: ARTIQ 固件构建服务客户端
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
实验控制固件构建与部署
device_entry.description: 用于连接 ARTIQ 固件构建服务的网络客户端，可通过 WebSocket 登录、提交指定版本和变体的构建请求，并读取文本或 JSON 格式的返回结果。该服务常用于为实验室中的 ARTIQ 控制硬件准备固件或相关构建产物。
device_entry.description_en: A network client for the ARTIQ firmware build service. It connects over WebSocket, logs in, submits build requests for specified versions and variants, and reads text or JSON replies. The service is typically used to prepare firmware or related build artifacts for ARTIQ laboratory control hardware.
